t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each colour gnome provides a value between 0-9 and are split into two groups. The corresponding value of a gnome may change depending on the X multiplier.

vb_textbox.text: Different coloured gnomes seem to provide different points on a scale of 0-9. I couldn't find a certain trend to predict what gnome would provide the most value at any given moment but I did a more colloquial one that may or may not be true. From my experience on a x5 multiplier a short hat red gnome would provide a value between 7-9 (35-45 total). The same also seemed to apply to a long hat purple and brown.
